data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Toro', meaning 'bull'. In Greek mythology, the bull was a symbol of strength and fertility. Torey could be seen as a bringer of joy, strength, and prosperity. The name Torey carries the meaning “Bringer of joy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Torey usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
